Table. Table 1 from prop:chain-ring-comparison

Experimental energy scales for the predicted-versus-observed \mathrm{C}_6 ring-closure barrier of prop:chain-ring-comparison: the C–C single-bond and benzene-resonance energies fix the relevant molecular scale, while the last two rows give the observed chain-to-ring barriers against which the substrate-parameter prediction is checked.

Quantity Experimental value Source
C–C single bond energy 346 \mathrm{kJ/mol} Standard thermochemistry
Benzene resonance stabilisation 150 \mathrm{kJ/mol} Hydrogenation calorimetry
\mathrm{C}_6 chain \to ring barrier (gas phase) \sim 200\text{--}400 \mathrm{kJ/mol} Ab initio (CCSD(T))
Bergman cyclisation (enediyne \to ring) \sim 120\text{--}170 \mathrm{kJ/mol} Experimental kinetics
